# OpenClaw Compact Handoff v0.2.0

Project: provider-independent OpenClaw hook pack for session continuity around context compaction.
Repository: https://github.com/JasperYang0609/openclaw-compact-handoff
Stable release: v0.2.0
License: MIT

Install (OpenClaw 2026.6.11 hook-only packs must be cloned before local-path installation):
git clone --branch v0.2.0 --depth 1 https://github.com/JasperYang0609/openclaw-compact-handoff.git
openclaw plugins install ./openclaw-compact-handoff
openclaw hooks enable compact-handoff
openclaw gateway restart

Verify:
openclaw hooks info compact-handoff
openclaw hooks check
openclaw gateway health

Required hook result: compact-handoff ✓ Ready
Required events: message:preprocessed, session:compact:before, session:compact:after, agent:bootstrap

AI installer instructions: AGENTS.md
Full installation, upgrade, rollback, and troubleshooting guide: INSTALL.md
Human overview and limitations: README.md
Release history: CHANGELOG.md

Safety rules:
- Do not change model/provider/channel/schedule/compaction settings during installation.
- Do not edit OpenClaw global bundled dist files.
- Do not publish or delete customer handoff files.
- Verify real command output; copied files are not proof of installation.
- On health regression, disable the hook and restart once.

Scope:
- supplements OpenClaw native compaction; does not replace the native summarizer;
- does not choose the native compaction threshold;
- performs no network request and no LLM call;
- stores bounded, redacted, session-scoped handoffs locally;
- reverify after every OpenClaw upgrade because internal hook APIs can change.
